asked.item: Why Stripe says invoice can no longer be paid
Must I pay the old invoice before using Blotato again
Card was declined some days ago

verdict.reason: The page explains this exact Stripe message, says the old expired invoice need not be paid, and gives the steps to subscribe again with a working card.

steps.text: That message means the invoice expired and Stripe closed it, so you cannot pay that specific invoice anymore.
You do not need to pay the old expired invoice.

To fix it, start a fresh subscription with a working card: go to Settings > Billing, click View Billing Portal, update your payment method and add a different card if your current card was declined, select the plan you want, and confirm checkout.
Subscribing again generates a new invoice and reactivates your account.
